metadata.title: Clicked like I was swatting invisible flies and still got a lone baffling kill?! Valorant broken...
metadata.description:
Spam clicked like my aim took a coffee break.
Enemy probably uninstalling out of confusion.
Pretending that was skill for a hot second.
Click if your aim’s a mess but luck still hits!

Tap if your aim’s a glorious disaster but the game still counts it!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
